title: A Bakery for the Summer Revisited
author: Ivo Reyes
blurb: Yara Blackwood, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
